options.content: **Azure · GCP · Railway** | Singapore time (UTC+8) · refresh 5 minutes. Red/orange lines mark verified capacity/configured limits. Shared Cloud SQL covers DEV, PROD and the agent. Missing samples are gaps, not zero.
